article.body_preview:
DHAKA, Feb 14, 2023 (BSS) - State Minister for Planning Dr Shamsul Alam today said that the country's economy is under control and in a comfortable zone while it is also getting vibrant amid the global shocks.

"The economy is getting vibrant and it is quite evident. The general point to point inflation is gradually coming down. So, I can say the economy is under control," he said.

The state minister said this while addressing the "DJFB Development Dialogue" as the chief guest held at the NEC C
